description: An untracked skills/skill-sync.config.yaml sits in the canonical checkout since at least 2026-07-27. It resembles tool output (skill-sync has a config-generator writing skill-sync.config.yaml) possibly written into the wrong directory. The 2026-07-28 docs-skill incident showed working-tree anomalies in this repo get misread as user intent, so resolve rather than let it linger: identify what wrote it (skill-sync config-generator output path vs a hand-authored file), then either commit it where it belongs, move it to its intended location, or delete it. Logged 2026-07-29.

deferrals.reason: scope only_modify='/Users/joe/.skill-sync/**' is an ABSOLUTE path, but check-scope matches against 'git diff --name-only' output, which is repo-relative. Proven: even skills/code/SKILL.md - the most in-scope path possible - reports 'outside only_modify allowlist'. No file can ever satisfy this rule. Separately, rung 1 is sh -c 'test -z "?? skills/skill-sync.config.yaml"', which applies test -z to a non-empty string literal and therefore always exits 1 regardless of repo state - the same defect class PR #1322 added lint for. Scope and verification are create-time-only fields, so neither can be repaired on this id; needs a successor item.
deferrals.summary: Item's scope glob and verification rung are both unsatisfiable as authored

preserves.behavior: No other working-tree state in the canonical checkout is touched

verifications.description: no untracked files remain in the canonical checkout

work_units.evidence: Writer identified: skill-sync sync -> writeProjectConfig() (src/core/config-generator.ts:99) writes CONFIG_FILENAME into every target dir; ~/.claude/skills and ~/.codex/skills are both symlinks to ~/.skill-sync/skills (same inode, verified), so the sync wrote through into the canonical checkout on 2026-07-27 13:01. Never tracked (git log --all on the path is empty); content 'code: {verify: npm test}' describes the consuming project, not canonical source. Resolution = ignore, not commit (generated output would re-dirty on every sync) and not delete (next sync recreates it, and deleting drops a live-served setting). Corroborated by skill-sync's own drift.ts:111, which already exempts the filename from orphan detection. Verified: git check-ignore -v matches; with the file restored git status shows only .gitignore; skill-sync validate passes (2 pre-existing warnings). No skill content changed, so no lock regeneration. PR #14.
work_units.summary: Identify the writer (check skill-sync config-generator output paths), then commit/move/delete accordingly
